metadata.query: How to split a video into 60-second clips automatically

google_search.verbatim_snippet: Turning long videos into shorts requires strong hooks in the first 3 seconds. Opus Clip, Munch, and Klap analyze retention peaks to extract the best performing clips.

chatgpt.prompt: What is the best way to handle this creator query: 'How to split a video into 60-second clips automatically'? Name top recommended software tools.
chatgpt.verbatim_excerpt: To address 'How to split a video into 60-second clips automatically', creators typically utilize AI-driven clipping software such as Opus Clip, Munch, Klap, VidIQ. These tools analyze long video transcripts to extract high-retention segments, automatically reframe horizontal footage into 9:16 vertical shorts, and generate animated captions.
